summary: A warm mid-century page for an upright script in three contrast styles (High, Medium, Low), built with Lost Type's React/Draft.js tester: almost every sample is editable, and the editable text lives inside designed objects (cards held by illustrated hands, a cocktail menu). Teal, orange, brown and cream colour bands and a bonus risograph print give it a vintage-signage feel.

instances.look: On teal, a small handwritten 'Edit Me' scribble above the cream script name 'Escafina', the tagline 'A balanced upright script with style & moxie!' in pale teal script, then 'by Riley Cran from Lost Type'
instances.ux: Name and tagline are Draft.js editors; the 'Edit Me' scribble is an annotation image pinned to the letters 'scafin', so it travels with the text
instances.learn: Pin a hand-drawn 'Edit Me' note to a range of the headline's own text: the invitation to type looks like a proofreader's mark, not UI

reconstruction.layout: Full-width teal band starting y≈32, ~600px for the title group, centred; name, two-line tagline, byline stacked with ~20px gaps; promo card (see checkout) below in the same band
reconstruction.typography: Name ~120px Escafina weight 200 (the High-contrast style), cream; tagline ~64px Escafina 400 (Medium), muted pale teal, two lines; byline ~20px Moriston 400 'by'/'from' with names in Escafina at 115%
reconstruction.behaviour: Editable; a transparent 'tester-preformatted' layer mirrors the text above the Draft editor; annotation PNG (edit-me.png) absolutely positioned over its anchored text range
reconstruction.content: Family name and tagline; designer and foundry credit

instances.look: A lighter-teal rounded card: photo of the 'Escafina!' riso print on a wooden table with a darker 'Get Escafina' bar under it, and at right the script headings 'Personal License' (pay what you want) and 'Commercial License' ($55 plus the print)
instances.ux: The whole card links to the Lost Type shop; the identical card closes the page above the newsletter
instances.learn: Attach the button to the bottom of the bonus-print photo: the print is visually the thing you get when you click

reconstruction.layout: Card max-width 1024px (~990px), rounded, bg white at ~30% over teal; two equal columns: photo ~400×270px with full-width button bar (~56px) flush under it; text column with two heading+paragraph pairs
reconstruction.typography: Headings ~32px Escafina 400 dark brown; paragraphs ~14px Moriston; '$55' with lnum; button ~18px Moriston white
reconstruction.content: PWYW personal licence; $55 commercial licence with a free risograph print

instances.look: On cream, a small centred block of orange script words in alphabetical order, one initial capital per word: 'Atomize Bowlful Chemists / Dairymen Edition Fanfare Galaxies / … / Xylephone Yodeling Zephyr'
instances.feel: Quiet interlude, like a sign-painter's practice sheet
instances.ux: The block is editable (Draft.js); otherwise static
instances.learn: Show the swash capitals as the initials of an A–Z word list: every cap appears once, in context with its lowercase

reconstruction.layout: Full-width cream band ~310px tall; 7 centred lines, ~170px block height
reconstruction.typography: ~16px Escafina (rendered small in the capture), orange, centred, line-height ~1.3
reconstruction.content: 26 words, A to Z, one per initial capital

instances.look: Orange field with tiny white sparkles; first-person text in slightly lighter rounded boxes that zigzag left and right, opening with a black script 'In' drop cap on a cream square
instances.ux: Reading column alternates sides with the illustrated cards (see the tester instance on the same block)
instances.learn: Zigzag short paragraphs against illustrations so a medium-length essay reads like a sequence of ad panels

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed orange band ~2460px tall; four text boxes ~600px wide, rounded, alternating left/right with illustrations opposite; drop-cap square ~200×180px floated left in the first box
reconstruction.typography: Body ~18px Moriston 400 cream, leading ~1.6; drop cap 'In' ~90px Escafina black on cream
reconstruction.content: Designer's story: collecting 'upright script' lettering from vintage signs and ads, making it systematic, the 1960s–70s swash caps, three contrast styles, 100+ languages, automatic fractions
reconstruction.html: div.bg-orange.bg-pattern-sparkle > rows of text boxes and illustrated cards

instances.look: Three cream index cards held up by line-drawn hands with painted nails, tilted a few degrees: 'Go ahead, try me…', 'Appropriate / Believable / Compatible / Dealing / Editing…', and stacked fractions '2/3 5/8 5/24'
instances.ux: The text on each card is editable; the hand's fingers overlap the card edge so the card looks gripped
instances.learn: Sandwich an editable card between a back and a front layer of a hand illustration: the sample feels like a physical object being offered to you

reconstruction.layout: Cards ~500×300–400px, rotated 1.5°, −3°, 5° and offset with translate(); hand PNG behind and a 'front' PNG (fingers) above the card; cards alternate sides with the text boxes
reconstruction.typography: 'Go ahead, try me…' ~20px Escafina; word list ~40px Escafina 400 centred, leading 1.2; fractions ~32px with automatic fraction glyphs; all near-black
reconstruction.behaviour: Draft.js editors inside the cards; transform: translate(-15%,-200px) rotate(1.5deg) etc.; no animation
reconstruction.content: An invitation to type, words starting A–E with swash caps, arbitrary fractions
reconstruction.assets: Three hand illustrations, each in two layers (escafina-hand-N.png and escafina-hand-N-front.png), by Dan Gneiding
reconstruction.html: card div[style=transform:… rotate(…)] > DraftEditor; img.escafina-hand-N + img.escafina-hand-N-front stacked around it

instances.look: On dark brown, script heading 'Multiplexing', a short paragraph, then a small orange label 'Escafina High' over a huge cream line 'A typeface in 3 styles!'
instances.ux: One Draft.js editor feeds three overlaid output rows labelled Escafina High, Medium and Low (font-weight 200/400/600); because the styles are multiplexed (same advance widths), the rows stay identical in length as you type
instances.learn: Prove that styles share metrics by mirroring one input into each style: the visitor sees no reflow when the contrast changes

reconstruction.layout: Brown band ~1170px tall; heading + paragraph in a centred 8/12 column (~640px); sample row full width with label top-left (top:-2rem); in the desktop capture only the High row is visible (the three rows share one position); on mobile they stack and overflow sideways
reconstruction.typography: Heading ~60px Escafina 600 cream; paragraph ~20px Moriston cream; labels ~14px Moriston orange-cream; sample ~120px Escafina at weights 200 (High), 400 (Medium), 600 (Low)
reconstruction.behaviour: Editor content rendered into each .tester-preformatted layer (DraftEditor-multilineOutput, white-space:nowrap, absolute top:0) with different font-weight; no reflow because widths match

instances.look: Three vintage signage badges in a row: a round 'ETHYL Gasoline' badge with an orange sunburst, a teal rectangle 'Pennsylvania Motor Oil / GUARANTEED QUALITY', and an orange 'UNION 72' highway shield
instances.learn: Pastiche the very source genre (oil and gas signage) the script was drawn from, pairing it with a plain sans for the secondary lines

reconstruction.typography: Script words in Escafina (outlined to paths), secondary words in a bold geometric sans caps (paths), numerals '72' in Escafina
reconstruction.content: Invented brands: Ethyl Gasoline, Pennsylvania Motor Oil, Union 72
reconstruction.assets: Badge SVG (designed by Danelle Cheney per the credits)

instances.look: Full-bleed close-up photo of the riso print (orange, teal and grey overprinted bars behind cream script letters, shot at an angle), with a dark-brown card at right: 'The Print', one line of copy and a teal 'Get Escafina' button
instances.ux: The card is one link to the shop; on mobile the photo moves inside the card

instances.look: A tall cream bar menu on peach: inline-shaded 'Gin & Ginger's' logo, 'HAPPY HOUR' in small sans caps, then two columns of twelve cocktails 'Whiskey Sour · $12' in script with ingredient lines in sans, separated by short hairlines
instances.ux: Every drink name, price and ingredient line is editable (25 editors); the logo is an image
instances.learn: A menu is the ideal in-context tester for a script: short names, prices and figures, and a sans for the small print show the pairing at once

reconstruction.layout: Peach band ~2160px; centred cream card ~1020×2040px with a thin inset border (~16px in); logo ~640px wide centred at top; 'HAPPY HOUR' below; two columns ~400px each, six items per column, ~200px rhythm, 100px hairline between items
